name: a5g6-evidence-rows
description: Identity sentinel for the GLUE-6 evidence row (observer). Two jobs, both measured: (1) the client-modules loader maps plugin rows to the NEAREST package.json — without this file the row resolves to the repo-root dsh-agent-team client package and boot refuses; (2) the plugin-package-inventory REQUEST EXTENSION reads that nearest package.json for EVERY model request and throws unless name AND version are non-empty. No dsh.client here: zero client surface.
